title: LA MINE D'OR ⛏️

scenes.image: In a dark gold mine tunnel lit by lanterns, a greedy boss with a giant pomegranate head in a black suit hands a thin envelope labeled PAIEMENT to a smiling miner with a banana head in blue overalls and a helmet with headlamp; other banana miners wait in line; stacks of cash on a wooden table.

lines.say: Le patron Grenade payait ses mineurs une misère.

scenes.image: Deep in the mine, the banana-head miner holds up a gigantic shining gold nugget, his headlamp lighting it, other banana miners gasp in amazement.

lines.say: Les gars… c'est la plus grosse pépite du monde !

scenes.image: The pomegranate-head boss in a suit storms in and grabs the gold nugget from the banana miner, evil grin.

lines.say: Donne-moi ça. Tout ce qui est dans ma mine m'appartient.

scenes.image: All the banana-head miners surround the shocked pomegranate-head boss, arms crossed, headlamps pointed at him, the first banana miner holding the gold nugget back, heroic low angle.

lines.say: Non. Cette fois, c'est nous les patrons.

caption:
⛏️ Le patron voulait voler la pépite… les mineurs ont dit NON 🔥

Team Banane ou Team Grenade ? 👇
Partie 2 ?
